meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'write', paired with 'написать'.

examples.text: Это писал какой-то продажный журналист!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'yesterday', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'счастливиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'was lucky enough'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и посчастливиться вовремя.

examples.text: Подождите минуту.
examples.trans: Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Что тут непонятного, приезжайте скорее.
examples.trans: What is unclear here, come quickly.

examples.text: Что у тебя там в руках?
examples.trans: What do you have there in your hands?

examples.text: Что тебе нужно, говори быстрее.
examples.trans: What do you need, speak faster.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'you (informal)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Виктор, ты этот тонкий намёк понял?
examples.trans: Viktor, did you understand that subtle hint?

examples.text: Поставь завтра на Спартак пятьдесят тысяч.
examples.trans: Put fifty thousand on Spartak tomorrow.

examples.text: Ты ей ещё сто тысяч должен.
examples.trans: You still owe her a hundred thousand.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'only', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вы только послушайте эти красивые слова.
examples.trans: Just listen to these beautiful words.

examples.text: Хорошо, иди, только не очень долго.
examples.trans: Alright, go, just not for very long.

examples.text: Денис, пожалуйста, только снова не начинай.
examples.trans: Denis, please, just do not start again.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'made', paired with 'делать'.

examples.text: Подожди, что ты только что сделал?
examples.trans: Wait, what did you just do?

examples.text: Мы однажды решили сделать тату с именами.
examples.trans: We once decided to get tattoos with our names.

examples.text: Подожди, ведь это сделала совсем не Катя.
examples.trans: Wait, after all it was not Katya at all who did this.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'published'.

examples.text: Шеф, я случайно опубликовал эту заметку.
examples.trans: Chef, I accidentally published this post.

examples.text: Опубликовать видео.
examples.trans: To publish a video.

examples.text: Кто-то опубликовал секретное видео в интернете!
examples.trans: Someone published a secret video on the internet!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Виктор, ты этот тонкий намёк понял?
examples.trans: Viktor, did you understand that subtle hint?

examples.text: Ой, это просто настоящий детский сад.
examples.trans: Oh, this is just a real kindergarten.

examples.text: Атмосфера этого ресторана подкупает каждого гостя.
examples.trans: The atmosphere of this restaurant wins over every guest.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'метка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'post / note' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Она машину совсем не заметила.
examples.trans: She did not notice the car at all.

examples.text: Шеф, я случайно опубликовал эту заметку.
examples.trans: Chef, I accidentally published this post.

examples.text: Быстро удали эту заметку!
examples.trans: Delete this post quickly!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'why', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А зачем ты за спиной хвалишь конкурента?
examples.trans: Then why are you praising a competitor behind my back?

examples.text: Зачем, ты и так потрясающе выглядишь.
examples.trans: Why, you look amazing as it is.

examples.text: Зачем ты нажал, давай скорее стирай!
examples.trans: Why did you press it, come on, erase it quickly!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'корее').

examples.text: Денис, дыши спокойно, сейчас вызовем скорую.
examples.trans: Denis, breathe calmly, we will call an ambulance now.

examples.text: Алло, скорая, у нас тут авария.
examples.trans: Hello, ambulance, we have an accident here.

examples.text: Что тут непонятного, приезжайте скорее.
examples.trans: What is unclear here, come quickly.

meanings.en: to do the washing, to wash clothes
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тирать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'erase', paired with 'постирать'.

examples.text: Зачем ты нажал, давай скорее стирай!
examples.trans: Why did you press it, come on, erase it quickly!

examples.text: Стирай немедленно, пока Лена не увидела!
examples.trans: Erase it immediately before Lena sees it!

examples.text: Я стираю рубашку.
examples.trans: I'm washing a shirt.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'медленно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Немедленно убери это и выйди отсюда!
examples.trans: Take this away immediately and get out of here!

examples.text: Немедленно закрой, хотя у меня есть идея!
examples.trans: Close it immediately, although I have an idea!

examples.text: Стирай немедленно, пока Лена не увидела!
examples.trans: Erase it immediately before Lena sees it!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'for now', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Денис, дыши спокойно, сейчас вызовем скорую.
examples.trans: Denis, breathe calmly, we will call an ambulance now.

examples.text: Женись спокойно, а я поставил деньги.
examples.trans: Get married in peace, and I placed a bet.

examples.text: Девочки, давайте сейчас немного успокоимся.
examples.trans: Girls, let us calm down a bit right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'not', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она машину совсем не заметила.
examples.trans: She did not notice the car at all.

examples.text: Что тут непонятного, приезжайте скорее.
examples.trans: What is unclear here, come quickly.

examples.text: Мы завтра ваших коней легко обыграем.
examples.trans: Tomorrow we will easily beat your horses.

meanings.en: to see, to catch sight of
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'видеть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to see', paired with 'видеть'.

examples.text: Я просто совсем не ожидал увидеть.
examples.trans: I just did not expect to see at all.

examples.text: Стирай немедленно, пока Лена не увидела!
examples.trans: Erase it immediately before Lena sees it!

examples.text: Вот увидишь!
examples.trans: You'll see!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Что тебе нужно, говори быстрее.
examples.trans: What do you need, speak faster.

examples.text: Ты снова носишься по кухне быстро.
examples.trans: You are rushing around the kitchen fast again.

examples.text: Пять минут, я сейчас очень быстро.
examples.trans: Five minutes, I will be very quick right now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'далить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to delete, to remove', paired with 'удалять'.

examples.text: Быстро удали эту заметку!
examples.trans: Delete this post quickly!

examples.text: Я её удалила.
examples.trans: I deleted it.

examples.text: Удали это фото.
examples.trans: Delete that photo.
